description: SISO's own parts for the gaps in the SISO set: comments, and the phone screens for settings, onboarding and sign in.

parts.title: Comments
parts.description: A composer, then a thread one reply deep: like and reply in place, the author's replies marked, top or newest first.

parts.title: Settings, mobile
parts.description: Settings on a phone: you at the top, grouped rows with values, switches and ways in, sign out alone at the bottom.

parts.title: Onboarding and sign in, mobile
parts.description: Three skippable screens, three ways in, then a six-digit email code that moves itself along, on a phone.
